description: The FROM phrase of WRITE, REWRITE and RELEASE with a literal operand (a figurative constant included) - a post-85 extension of the phrase. ONE grammar rule (recordFromPhrase) carries the phrase for all three statements and ONE parse-arm gate (VisitRecordFromPhrase) asks its edge (kb/Work PB2650: the gate used to be RELEASE's alone).
vcr: VCR row 7.34 (2002 introduction, derived; present in the 2023 §2023:14.9.51.2 / §2023:14.9.35.2 / §2023:14.9.32.2 formats)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWRFL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "rwrfl.dat"
        ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
    SELECT S-F ASSIGN TO "rwrfl.tmp".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 F-REC PIC X(5).
SD S-F.
01 S-REC PIC X(5).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-REC PIC X(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    WRITE F-REC FROM "HELLO".
    CLOSE F.
    OPEN I-O F.
    READ F.
    REWRITE F-REC FROM SPACE.
    CLOSE F.
    SORT S-F ON ASCENDING KEY S-REC
        INPUT PROCEDURE IS IP
        OUTPUT PROCEDURE IS OP.
    STOP RUN.
IP.
    RELEASE S-REC FROM "HELLO".
OP.
    RETURN S-F INTO W-REC AT END CONTINUE END-RETURN.
